title: Constant-tower and semilinear-counit normalizations of integral compactification composition agree
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$, $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be separated finite-type morphisms of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and put $h=gf$. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], put $\widehat R_T=\lim_n(A_n)_T$. Use the strict semilinear system category $\mathscr S_T$, reduction/total-limit adjunction $\mathcal R_T\dashv\mathcal L_T$, and its actual unit $u$ and counit $e$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Let $K$ be derived-complete constructible with finite Tor amplitude. Require every system and intermediate object below to have compatible etale-origin witnesses and normalized reductions, with cohomological and Tor amplitudes in common finite intervals, as specified in [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization].

Choose a compatible tower of compactifications $c_f,c_g,c_h$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]: each $c_v=(j_v,p_v)$ has $j_v$ quasi-compact open, $p_v$ proper, and $v=p_vj_v$, and the compatible intermediate proper/open square supplies the compactification of $h$. Write $B_v=S_{p_v}J_{j_v}$ on semilinear systems, with system direct image $S$ and termwise open extension $J$. Let $\beta:B_gB_f\to B_h$ be the compactification composition map formed from the canonical proper/open map $\Gamma_Q$ and the unital direct-image/open compositors of [lem-sf-ambient-proper-open-pasting]. Let $F_v=Rv_!$ be exactly the integral reduction-tower functor of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Denote by
$$d_{v,M}:\mathcal L B_v\mathcal R M\xrightarrow{\sim}F_vM$$
the direct identification with that functor's defining strict quotient tower and total-limit model, with its specified quotient transitions. These are direct identifications for a single compactification, rather than an unspecified choice of the expression-realization family $c_V$. For the identity compactification $(\mathrm{id},\mathrm{id})$, after the canonical system unitors identify $B_{\mathrm{id}}$ with $1$, one has $F_{\mathrm{id}}=\mathcal L\mathcal R$ and $d_{\mathrm{id},M}=1_{\mathcal L\mathcal R M}$.

For constant $R$-module coordinates, let $H_T$ be restriction along $\underline R_T\to\widehat R_T$ on complete complexes, the equivalence of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Use the strict constant towers and their total-limit functor $\mathcal L^{\mathcal T}$ and reduction $\mathcal R^{\mathcal T}$. Let $W_v$ be the word consisting of proper direct image after completed open extension for $c_v$, and $\widetilde W_v$ its strict constant-tower word. Let
$$a_{v,K}:H(F_vK)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal L^{\mathcal T}\widetilde W_v\mathcal R^{\mathcal T}(HK),\qquad
 a_{g,f,K}:H(F_gF_fK)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal L^{\mathcal T}\widetilde W_g\widetilde W_f\mathcal R^{\mathcal T}(HK)$$
be precisely the normalized word comparisons $a_W=\mathcal L^{\mathcal T}(q_W)\eta$, with the recursive $q_W$ and generator normalizations of [lem-sf-cbc-compact-support-composition-limit], using the canonical compact-support and constant/completed coefficient identifications. The single-compactification identifications here use the canonical direct-image/derived-limit comparison and the open comparison fixed by reduction of the completion unit, as specified by the same word-comparison theorem; they are not arbitrary isomorphisms between these functors. Let $\beta^{\mathcal T}$ be the constant-tower proper/open composition map for the same compactification tower, formed from the normalized strict-tower proper/open comparison $\gamma_Q$ and the canonical direct-image and open-extension compositors of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus], and let $\alpha^{\mathrm{cbc}}_{g,f}:F_gF_f\to F_h$ be the specified completed composition comparison in [fix-lem-exchanges](2),(4); in these coordinates its components are
$$H(\alpha^{\mathrm{cbc}}_{g,f,K})=a_{h,K}^{-1}\circ\mathcal L^{\mathcal T}(\beta^{\mathcal T})\circ a_{g,f,K}.$$
Then the following is an equality of actual integral morphisms $F_gF_fK\to F_hK$:
$$\alpha^{\mathrm{cbc}}_{g,f,K}
=d_{h,K}\circ\mathcal L_Z(\beta_{\mathcal R_XK})\circ\mathcal L_Z\bigl(B_g(e_{B_f\mathcal R_XK})\bigr)\circ\mathcal L_ZB_g\mathcal R_Y(d_{f,K}^{-1})\circ d_{g,F_fK}^{-1}.$$
The equality is natural in $K$ for the supplied compatible compactification tower, including towers with an identity or empty open. It compares the specified constant-tower word normalization and the specified semilinear counit normalization before any finite evaluation; no arbitrary choice of intertwining realizations is used.
